nodes.label: yfinance rate-limit risk
nodes.rationale: Only history and options endpoints add backend calls, both user-triggered rather than polled.

nodes.label: NSE low-latency quote source
nodes.rationale: nseindia.com/api/allIndices is fresher than Yahoo for NIFTY/BANKNIFTY/NIFTYIT; unofficial endpoint so /api/quote must silently fall back to yfinance on any failure. Used for quotes only, not OHLC history.

nodes.label: Range-change listener firing on programmatic changes (bug)
nodes.rationale: Root cause of rubber-band/hidden-9:15 glitch and >1Y shows nothing: subscribeVisibleLogicalRangeChange fired on fitContent()/setData() side effects, causing premature prefetch and duplicate/non-monotonic timestamps from /api/candles/history that Lightweight-Charts rejects, breaking the chart instance until reload. 1Y/YTD resolve to 1h so bypassed the 1d guard.
nodes.norm_label: range-change listener firing on programmatic changes (bug)

nodes.label: Loading indicator for candle fetches
nodes.rationale: QA could not reproduce ALL/YTD->1D not readjusting; working theory is a 1.5-2.5s yfinance round trip with no feedback reads as broken. Mitigation, not a confirmed bug fix.

nodes.label: Stale request race (bug) and mitigations
nodes.rationale: Flask dev server was single-threaded so stale requests queued ahead of the latest. Fix: threaded=True, client AbortController, loadGeneration counter as defense in depth. Verified with 5-scenario Playwright stress test.

nodes.label: Jump-on-prepend risk and logical-range restore
nodes.rationale: Prepending older bars via setData() resets visible range unless setVisibleLogicalRange is restored after merge.

nodes.label: Mouse-wheel granularity auto-switch
nodes.rationale: TradingView-like: interval auto-switches 1m->5m->15m->1h->1d while preserving visible window. Initially thresholded on calendar span (later found to self-trigger); rewritten to visible bar count.

nodes.label: Granularity threshold on calendar span self-triggered (bug)
nodes.rationale: A normal 1D of 1m bars spans 6+ hours, exceeding the 2-hour threshold, so 1D showed 5m. Fixed by thresholding on visible bar count (40-500 band), market/timezone agnostic.
nodes.norm_label: granularity threshold on calendar span self-triggered (bug)

nodes.label: yfinance data gaps (no NIFTY options, no NSE futures)
nodes.rationale: Verified live: ^NSEI has empty Ticker.options; NIFTY_FUT, NIFTY.NS, ^NSEI=F all 404; global futures NQ=F, ES=F resolve. Real data-source gap, not a bug; never fabricate data.
nodes.norm_label: yfinance data gaps (no nifty options, no nse futures)

nodes.label: Cash/Futures toggle scope decision
nodes.rationale: Toggle dropped for NIFTY/BANKNIFTY/NIFTYIT (cash only, not even disabled) because yfinance has no NSE futures ticker; kept for SPX->ES=F, NASDAQ->NQ=F, DOWJONES->YM=F.

nodes.label: Options panel scoped by data availability
nodes.rationale: Endpoints must return structured {available:false, reason} instead of 500 so frontend shows explicit unavailable state; US symbols like AAPL have real chains.
nodes.norm_label: options panel scoped by data availability

nodes.label: Candle freshness: patch last bar from 5s quote tick
nodes.rationale: Reuses existing 5s quote poll so no new backend load; 60s refetch stays as authoritative resync. todo.md found this already existed; the perceived 1-min lag is upstream Yahoo delay.
nodes.norm_label: candle freshness: patch last bar from 5s quote tick

nodes.label: All range truncated by minBarSpacing (bug)
nodes.rationale: Default minBarSpacing 0.5px clamps fitContent past ~2300 bars, anchoring to recent data silently; All (4662 daily bars) showed only ~2170. Fix: timeScale.minBarSpacing 0.05.

nodes.label: Playwright / chrome-devtools QA testing
nodes.rationale: No devtools MCP initially, so root-causing was by code reading; later Playwright headless Chrome and a QA subagent with chrome-devtools MCP found real bugs.

nodes.label: pollQuote stale-symbol response (bug)
nodes.rationale: Quote fetch for pre-switch symbol resolved after switch, showing NASDAQ price on NIFTY and folding it into last candle on 1D. Fix: capture symbolAtRequest and discard if it no longer matches currentSymbol.

nodes.label: Volume pane shrink (scaleMargins)
nodes.rationale: Volume scaleMargins.top raised 0.8 -> 0.88 -> 0.93 with price-scale bottom margin 0.35 so volume is a thin strip not overlapping candles.

nodes.label: Range click reused wider range's interval (bug)
nodes.rationale: Backend interval ladder only escalates coarser, so clicking 1D after YTD kept 1h. Fix: range-bar clicks always request interval=1m baseline.
nodes.norm_label: range click reused wider range's interval (bug)

nodes.label: Server-side interval/range validation boundary
nodes.rationale: Always keep interval+range validation in resolve_interval_range so the frontend never requests combos yfinance cannot serve.

nodes.label: Day/session boundary indication
nodes.rationale: Evolved: setMarkers arrows (overlapped candles) -> tick-label full date -> thin dotted vertical DOM overlay (#day-lines) because Lightweight Charts v4 has no primitives API.

nodes.label: Left quick-access index rail
nodes.rationale: Fixed static list (NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, NIFTYIT, SPX, NASDAQ, DOWJONES, KOSPI, TAIEX; later SENSEX, CHINA=000001.SS), served via /api/config quickIndices; not user-editable.

nodes.label: Search dropdown reopening after Enter (bug)
nodes.rationale: Pending debounced search fetch could resolve after Enter and reopen dropdown with stale results; fix clears searchDebounce on Enter.

nodes.label: Build order (independent vs sequential)
nodes.rationale: Freshness -> history -> boundary markers (needs merged dataset) -> futures toggle -> options last (most isolated, likeliest data-gap path).
